cards.heading: How many laser hair removal sessions do most people need?
title: How Many
Sessions
cards.alt: Most people need six to nine laser hair removal sessions, spaced about six weeks apart
cards.statLine: sessions for the best result, not the one or two most people expect
cards.source: American Society for Laser Medicine and Surgery

cards.heading: How many sessions for legs, underarms, bikini, and face?
title: Sessions
Area by Area
cards.alt: Typical session counts by area: underarms, bikini and lower legs 6 to 8, back, chest and face 8 or more

cards.heading: Does hair color change how many sessions you need?
title: Does
Hair Colour
Matter?
cards.alt: Laser targets pigment, so dark coarse hair responds well while grey, white, red and blonde do not

bad.heading: Responds poorly
items: Too little pigment to absorb light

cards.heading: What should you do before and after a session?
title: Before and
After
cards.alt: Shave the day before, avoid waxing for four weeks, skip sun and self-tanner, and no heat for 24 hours after

items.label: Shave the day before
items.note: The follicle must stay intact below the skin

items.label: No waxing for 4 weeks
items.note: Plucking and threading remove the target

items.label: No heat for 24 hours
items.note: Skip hot tubs, saunas and hard workouts

cards.heading: What is Laser Genesis? The "Lunchtime Facial" Explained
title: How
Laser Genesis
Works
cards.alt: Laser Genesis gently heats the upper dermis, triggers the healing response, and builds new collagen

steps.label: Gentle heat
steps.note: 1064 nm warms the upper dermis without breaking the surface

steps.label: Healing response
steps.note: The body's natural repair process is triggered

steps.label: New collagen
steps.note: Neocollagenesis smooths texture over 3 to 6 sessions

cards.heading: What is IPL (Intense Pulsed Light)? Targeting Sun Damage and Redness
title: What
IPL
Treats
cards.alt: IPL targets sunspots and age spots, broken capillaries, and rosacea-related flushing

title: Laser Genesis vs
